entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-03
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Rename dialog doesn't warn about conflicts new name will introduce #81535
  • Evaluate `#:project` directives in the editor #81533
    18.4
  • Possible Span<T>/ROS<T> overload resolution bug with implicit conversion (or missing priority increase for MemoryMarshal.AsRef) #81528
  • Feature "Source Generation" is unavailable #81527

Closed

  • When creating class library in VS, it reverts to block-scoped namespace #79231
    Backlog
  • Add EmitDifferenceOptions.DisallowExplicitMethodImplementations #81305
  • `CS8389` not reported on missing type arguments in a dynamic invocation case. #80419
    Backlog
  • Visual Studio 2026 - InvalidCastException #81530
  • Improve error messages when variable designation is in incorrect order with property pattern #50220
    Backlog
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11302.21 #81525
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11302.122 #81524

PullRequests

Created

  • Generate docs - fix an issue where the suggestion session was being overtaken #81537
    Area-IDE
  • Use ArrayExpansion for fixed buffer fields #81536
    Area-Interactive, Community
  • Ensure calls to OOP for source-generator purposes see the exact same Solution-snapshot-instances across all calls they make #81529
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Dismiss and suppress gray text proposals for the duration of the event hookup session #81526
    Area-IDE, Community

Merged

  • Merge latest bits from `main` into `features/extensions` #81534
    Needs UX Triage, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Track runtime-async-streams feature as part of runtime-async work #81447
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • EnC: Block additions to MethodImpl table when targeting .NET Framework #81304
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode, Next
  • Add empty CSharp15 test project #81512
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Fix missing diagnostic about omitted type args on dynamic member access. #81495
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Fix InvalidCastException in ConvertForToForEach with tuples #81531
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Add Extension Indexers feature to Language Status #81506
    Area-Compilers, Documentation, Next
  • Merge latest bits from `main` into `features/extensions` #81504
    Needs UX Triage, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Fix 'new project' not properly reading current user options when formatting initial files #81523
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Improve error message for misplaced variable designator in property patterns #81287
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Add EnableFileBasedProgramsWhenAmbiguous flag #81513
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode, Next
  • Formatting options pages - remove focus from content control #81522
    Area-IDE, Needs UX Triage, Next

Updated

  • Emit async-iterators with runtime-async when possible #81314
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Do not report parse errors for '#:' in miscellaneous files #81385
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Feature - Run File
  • Unsafe evolution: add `MemorySafetyRules` attribute #81441
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Add IOp support for `with(...)` elements. #81427
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Assert shape of the bound tree #81486
    Area-Compilers
  • Add separate error for disallowed members in global namespace #81221
    Area-Compilers, Community, Needs UX Triage, VSCode
  • Adjust behavior of is-type operator for `Union` types #81448
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Fix null refs when calling `GetLocation()` or `GetDiagnostics()` of freshly constructed syntax trivia #81444
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Implement exhaustiveness check for Union types #81442
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Closed Class Hierarchies, Feature - Unions
  • [do not merge] Init logging #81348
    Needs API Review, VSCode
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #81478
    Area-Infrastructure
